  else bmmPackedBase batch m n p A B

    (B : Vector Binary32 (batch * n * p)),

  intro batch m n p A B
  unfold bmm
  split
  · rw [DirectSmall.core_eq_reference]
    exact referenceBmm_spec batch m n p A B
